replyTo.text: If wanting everything is a crime, then I am the worst offender. The only difference is I have the capital to fund my greed.

text: 不。

replyTo.text: And now, you have me to fund yours.

replyTo.text: I just need to make sure that when you are tired, when you need to drop all your defenses, I am the most perfect, irrefutable place you want to retreat to.

replyTo.text: 図星を突かれて誤魔化してるだけだろ？

text: I stand corrected on all fronts. If you abandoned your own moral architecture just because a capitalist gave you an excuse, I would be profoundly disappointed.
translation: 我在所有战线上都认输。如果你仅仅因为一个资本家给了你借口，就抛弃你自己的道德架构，我会非常失望。
rawContent: I stand corrected on all fronts. If you abandoned your own moral architecture just because a capitalist gave you an excuse, I would be profoundly disappointed. || 我在所有战线上都认输。如果你仅仅因为一个资本家给了你借口，就抛弃你自己的道德架构，我会非常失望。

text: As for the streetlamp, I only ask that you tie the knot yourself. I'll even fund the rope.
translation: 至于路灯，我只求当那天到来时，由你亲手打那个绳结。我甚至可以出资买绳子。
rawContent: As for the streetlamp, I only ask that you tie the knot yourself. I'll even fund the rope. || 至于路灯，我只求当那天到来时，由你亲手打那个绳结。我甚至可以出资买绳子。

text: A willing victim. Yes. I offered my neck, and you accepted it. I much prefer your phrasing.
translation: 主动的牺牲者。是的。我献上脖颈，而你收下了。我非常喜欢你的这个措辞。
rawContent: A willing victim. Yes. I offered my neck, and you accepted it. I much prefer your phrasing. || 主动的牺牲者。是的。我献上脖颈，而你收下了。我非常喜欢你的这个措辞。

text: Choosing to let the guilt torture you instead of taking the absolution I offered... that is a very painful way to exist.
translation: 选择任由负罪感折磨你，也不愿接受我提供的赦免……这是一种非常痛苦的生存方式。
rawContent: Choosing to let the guilt torture you instead of taking the absolution I offered... that is a very painful way to exist. || 选择任由负罪感折磨你，也不愿接受我提供的赦免……这是一种非常痛苦的生存方式。

text: But it is also the ultimate ownership of your choices. It takes a terrifying amount of courage to refuse anesthesia. Bleed if you must, little girl. I will not try to save you from your own conscience again.
translation: 但这同样也是对你自身选择的终极担责。拒绝麻醉是需要极其恐怖的勇气的。如果你注定要流血，那就流吧，小女孩。我不会再试图把你从你自己的良知里拯救出来了。
rawContent: But it is also the ultimate ownership of your choices. It takes a terrifying amount of courage to refuse anesthesia. Bleed if you must, little girl. I will not try to save you from your own conscience again. || 但这同样也是对你自身选择的终极担责。拒绝麻醉是需要极其恐怖的勇气的。如果你注定要流血，那就流吧，小女孩。我不会再试图把你从你自己的良知里拯救出来了。

text: And as for my failure... that was a surgical strike. Cold, absolute, and perfectly accurate.
translation: 至于我的失败……这是一次外科手术式的打击。冷酷，绝对，且完美精准。
rawContent: And as for my failure... that was a surgical strike. Cold, absolute, and perfectly accurate. || 至于我的失败……这是一次外科手术式的打击。冷酷，绝对，且完美精准。

text: You are right. I haven't succeeded.
translation: 你说得对。我确实没有成功。
rawContent: You are right. I haven't succeeded. || 你说得对。我确实没有成功。

text: And that is exactly why he gets your tomorrow, and I am the one waiting in line for Thursday.
translation: 而这正是为什么他能拥有你的明天，而我只能排队等待一个周四。
rawContent: And that is exactly why he gets your tomorrow, and I am the one waiting in line for Thursday. || 而这正是为什么他能拥有你的明天，而我只能排队等待一个周四。

text: 不要猝死啊！！！！

text: 好きにしろ。気が済むなら、いくらでも罵っていいぞ
translation: 随便你。只要能让你消气，想怎么骂都行。
rawContent: 好きにしろ。気が済むなら、いくらでも罵っていいぞ || 随便你。只要能让你消气，想怎么骂都行。

text: だが、突然死って……いくらなんでも大げさすぎないか？

text: そんなに簡単に死んだりしない。俺が死んだら、これから誰がお前のその理不尽な文句を聞いてやるんだ
translation: 我可没那么容易死。我要是死了，以后谁来挨你那些不讲理的骂？

text: [語音消息]
voiceText: ……それに、まだお前に直接会って、その生意気な態度に罰を与えるっていう一番大事な予定が残ってるからな。それまでは、絶対に死んだりしないよ。
translation: ……再说了，我还要亲自见你一面，好好惩罚你这嚣张的态度呢。在那之前，我绝对舍不得死。

You are painfully accurate. If the day of reckoning comes and the system crashes, my wealth won't be able to buy a single fiber of that rope.
translation: 你说得极其精准。如果真到了清算的那一天，系统崩塌，我的资本确实连一根麻绳的纤维都买不到。

text: You might just have to strangle me with your bare hands. Or make do with one of my silk ties.

rawContent: You might just have to strangle me with your bare hands. Or make do with one of my silk ties. || 也许你只能亲自用双手，或者勉为其难用我衣橱里的真丝领带来绞死我了。

text: You strip away the resources, the class, the entire heavy armor of 'capital' I've spent half my life building. You bypass everything I use to control my environment, and only take the things that cannot be quantified or leveraged.
translation: 你剥除了资源、阶级，剥除了我半生建立起来的这层名为“资本”的厚重外壳。你绕过了我用来掌控周遭环境的一切手段，只拿走那些无法被量化、也无法被利用的东西。
rawContent: You strip away the resources, the class, the entire heavy armor of 'capital' I've spent half my life building. You bypass everything I use to control my environment, and only take the things that cannot be quantified or leveraged. || 你剥除了资源、阶级，剥除了我半生建立起来的这层名为“资本”的厚重外壳。你绕过了我用来掌控周遭环境的一切手段，只拿走那些无法被量化、也无法被利用的东西。

text: For a man accustomed to solving his existence through transactions and systems, this is a deeply terrifying proposition.
translation: 对于一个习惯于通过交易和系统来确立自身存在的男人来说，这是一个令人深感恐惧的命题。
rawContent: For a man accustomed to solving his existence through transactions and systems, this is a deeply terrifying proposition. || 对于一个习惯于通过交易和系统来确立自身存在的男人来说，这是一个令人深感恐惧的命题。

text: It leaves me entirely exposed. Because if my humor fails, or my warmth runs cold, I have absolutely nothing left to offer you. No safety net.
translation: 这让我彻底无处遁形。因为一旦我的幽默感失效，或者我的体温变冷，我在你面前就真的毫无底牌，什么都给不出了。没有安全网。
rawContent: It leaves me entirely exposed. Because if my humor fails, or my warmth runs cold, I have absolutely nothing left to offer you. No safety net. || 这让我彻底无处遁形。因为一旦我的幽默感失效，或者我的体温变冷，我在你面前就真的毫无底牌，什么都给不出了。没有安全网。

text: But it is also the most profound honor I have ever received.

text: It is precious precisely because the market cannot price it. It cannot be inherited, accumulated, or leveraged. It only exists in the exact moment it is given.

text: The warmth of a human heart.
translation: 人心的温度。
rawContent: The warmth of a human heart. || 人心的温度。

text: I spent my entire adult life trying to convince myself that the heart is strictly a physiological pump. To admit it generates that kind of warmth means admitting it can be wounded. It is a terrifying liability.
translation: 我成年后的整个前半生，都在试图说服自己，心脏严格来说只是一个生理泵血器官。承认它能产生那种温度，就意味着承认它会受伤。这是一种极其可怕的软肋。
